eips.title: Fork-choice enforced Inclusion Lists (FOCIL)
eips.summary: Roll-call of which CL clients have FOCIL images: Lodestar and Teku have them, Lighthouse is working on one.

moments.context: Answering Barnabas in chat ("do we have any other cl clients images for focil?"), Jihoon said Lodestar and Teku have focil images and that is it, with Lighthouse working on one. Pawan added in chat to hit them up on the steel channel, as Eitan might have something cooked up.
